title: Transactivation DNA-binding protein-related genes were associated with salivary gland injury in primary Sjogren syndrome.
authors: Zhang, Naidan; Zhang, Hongsheng; Bao, Xiao; Yuan, Chengliang
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过机器学习筛选干燥综合征唾液腺损伤相关基因并验证表达，但仅涉及基因表达与免疫关联，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The purpose was to identify transactivation DNA-binding protein-related genes in salivary gland injury in primary Sjogren syndrome (pSS) in southwest China. We downloaded the datasets of GSE7451, GSE23117, and GSE40611. In order to screen the candidate genes, 2 kinds of machine learning algorithms were used. We collected blood from 28 patients and 20 controls to verify the expression of candidate genes using quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction. The receiver operating characteristic curve was used to evaluate the diagnostic efficiency. Correlations between candidate genes and immune cells were examined. A total of 31 differentially expressed genes were obtained. Through different algorithms, 6 genes including IFIT1, CSF2RB, TRIM22, PPM1H, VAMP7, and C21orf2 were getted. Validation results suggested that the expression of CSF2RB, VAMP7, IFIT1, C21orf2, and TRIM22 was significantly increased in pSS. The area under the curve of CSF2RB was 0.937 and that of TRIM22 was 0.915. Immune infiltration analysis showed that the percentage of activated mast cells was lower than the controls (P = .025). Correlation analysis suggested that CSF2RB was associated with immune cell infiltration. The expression of CSF2RB was significantly upregulated, which could be related to the increase of gammadelta T cells. We revealed that CSF2RB could be the candidate gene of pSS. CSF2RB was involved by regulating various immune cells. The expression of CSF2RB was significantly upregulated, which was related to the increase of gammadelta T cells.
abstract_zh: 目的是鉴定中国西南地区原发性干燥综合征（pSS）中唾液腺损伤相关的反式激活DNA结合蛋白基因。我们下载了GSE7451、GSE23117和GSE40611数据集。为了筛选候选基因，使用了2种机器学习算法。我们收集了28名患者和20名对照者的血液，通过定量实时聚合酶链反应验证候选基因的表达。采用受试者工作特征曲线评估诊断效率。检查了候选基因与免疫细胞之间的相关性。共获得31个差异表达基因。通过不同算法，得到6个基因，包括IFIT1、CSF2RB、TRIM22、PPM1H、VAMP7和C21orf2。验证结果表明，CSF2RB、VAMP7、IFIT1、C21orf2和TRIM22在pSS中的表达显著升高。CSF2RB的曲线下面积为0.937，TRIM22的为0.915。免疫浸润分析显示，活化肥大细胞的百分比低于对照组（P = .025）。相关性分析表明，CSF2RB与免疫细胞浸润相关。CSF2RB的表达显著上调，这可能与γδ T细胞的增加有关。我们揭示CSF2RB可能是pSS的候选基因。CSF2RB通过调节多种免疫细胞参与其中。CSF2RB的表达显著上调，这与γδ T细胞的增加相关。
